stem.text: A sphere falls from rest through the air. The graph shows the variation with time of the sphere's velocity.

stem.alt: Velocity against time graph for a falling sphere: velocity starts at zero and increases with decreasing gradient, levelling off; point P is on the steep early part of the curve

stem.text: Which diagram shows the forces acting on the sphere when it is at the velocity corresponding to point P on the graph?

A.alt: Sphere with an upward arrow labelled air resistance, about equal in length to the downward arrow labelled weight

B.alt: Sphere with only a downward arrow labelled weight

C.alt: Sphere with an upward arrow labelled air resistance, shorter than the downward arrow labelled weight

D.alt: Sphere with an upward arrow labelled air resistance, longer than the downward arrow labelled weight
